service_reference.scope: General historical service reference, not a model-specific instruction or universal reset method.
summary: Support watch on a soft surface before opening.
Screw-in back: use an adjustable opener counter-clockwise; snap-on versions use the illustrated appropriate opening tool/recess.
Release the battery holder, replace the cell, and refit the holder. Avoid touching the negative contact or bridging contacts with metal tweezers.
Where the illustrated module specifies it, connect AC to battery positive for about two seconds; some models require pressing the light button to activate the display.
Refit the screw-in or snap-on back using the appropriate tool or gentle press.
not_inferred: No individual module compatibility from illustrative service photographs
No factory-code meaning from illustrative caseback text
No present-day water-resistance certification after service

discrepancies.subject: Catalog year
discrepancies.detail: 1983 is supplied attribution; CT0583E is preserved without decoding.

discrepancies.subject: Module 160 stopwatch modes
discrepancies.detail: Page 1 lists net/lap/first-second place modes; page 3 lists normal/net/first-second place modes. Preserve both source representations.

discrepancies.subject: Module 215 temperature
discrepancies.detail: Printed –10°C / 13°F lower endpoint is not an exact conversion. No correction silently substituted.

discrepancies.subject: Modules 119/120 countdown range
discrepancies.detail: Feature strip says maximum 12 hours; technical table says 11 hr 59 min.

discrepancies.subject: F-11 packaging calendar
discrepancies.detail: Packaging describes a constant calendar; the module 155 technical table specifically says auto-calendar set at 28 days for February. Preserve the technical limitation alongside the broader packaging description.

discrepancies.subject: Material captions
discrepancies.detail: Plain Resin/Stainless steel/Gold plated captions do not separately establish band material or alloy. Explicit case wording is retained verbatim; no physical fields propagated through modules.

discrepancies.subject: Clocks conversions
discrepancies.detail: Metric and imperial dimension/weight rows are retained as separate printed claims; some are not precise conversions.
